title: Blue/green and canary releases with CodeDeploy

videos.script: A release is ready. The question is not whether it works. Somebody tested that. The question is what happens if it does not. {{question}} Switch everything at once, and every customer meets the problem together. {{switch}} Blue and green keep both versions running. The traffic moves from one to the other, and it can move back in seconds. {{bluegreen}} A canary moves a small share first. Ten percent, for five minutes. If something is wrong, only a few customers see it. {{canary}} But only if something notices. This lesson counts a bad release through each strategy. One alarm watches the whole service. The other watches only the new version. One of the two makes the canary worse than no canary at all. {{count}} Then the limit of every rollback. It moves traffic. It does not move data. {{data}} By the end, you can design a deployment group whose rollback actually happens, and a release the previous version can survive. {{end}}
